summary: PRIVILEGE_DENIED sentinel leaks into serialized lists, causing HTTP 500
description:
Affected: Any version with RESTWS-1024
  Repro
User has Get Visits but not Get Encounters.

Visit has ≥ 1 encounter.

GET /ws/rest/v1/visit/{uuid} → HTTP 500, No serializer found for class java.lang.Object (SimpleObject["encounters"]->ArrayList[0]).

  Cause
  PRIVILEGE_DENIED is a raw Object returned for denied child resources. The top-level filter drops it, but per-element loops in ConversionUtil and DelegatingResourceDescription.Property.evaluate doesn't,  the raw Object lands in the list, and Jackson fails.
